description.value: Functioning as a built-in limscanner, sensors in your eyes are calibrated to detect fluctuations in planar energies found inside the Ghost Levels, allowing you to scan for certain anomalies during a limdive or while investigating oddities across the galaxy. You gain a +1 item bonus to Perception checks to find magical traps, to AC against attacks made by magical traps, and to saves against magical traps. Even if you aren't Searching, you get a check to find magical traps that normally require you to be Searching. You cannot Disable traps without the otherwise required proficiency.
